confidence_notes: Jaipur-specific aggregated price data supports the meal, cappuccino, and draft-beer estimates. Cocktail is estimated from the current local cocktail-to-beer price relationship; wine is set at roughly twice a draft beer because a reliable current restaurant glass price was not available. The cocktail data is based on very few local submissions. Accommodation values are holistic estimates from general knowledge, not live listings, and are less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city proxy was needed for food and drink because Jaipur-specific cost-of-living data was available. Accommodation reflects Jaipur as a major domestic and international tourism city in a lower-cost Indian market.
